nodes.label: UADER Logo (Universidad Autónoma de Entre Ríos)
nodes.description: SVG wordmark/logotype for UADER (Universidad Autónoma de Entre Ríos), an Argentine public university located in Entre Ríos province. The logo renders the acronym 'UADER' in a bold custom typeface using the institution's brand colors: dark blue (#005385 / #005485) for the letter forms and a crimson/deep red (#AB152B) as an accent element. The SVG is 788×160px, a wide horizontal format typical of a text-only wordmark. Used in the landing page members/partners section of the La Nube coworking platform.
